To organize a custom match, you must have two light or full parties willing to participate. Once invitations have been sent, the leader of the Claws can continue the registration process by pressing the Join button. ※Spectator parties must have at least two members. ※Invitations for spectator parties cannot be sent until participating parties have been formed. ※When organizing a custom match, the leaders of the participating and spectating parties must be in the same area. ※Undersized party settings are ignored in custom matches. ※The following will cancel match registration: 　・A party leader leaves the area 　・A party leader is changed 　・A party member logs out 　・A new member joins a party 　・A member leaves a party 　・A party is disbanded 　・A party declines the match registration 　・The “Cancel All” button is pressed

The 95Returner status is applied to players who have at least one class at level 50 or above, have not visited Eorzea in more than 45 days, and have accepted the Returner's Bounty. The Returner's Bounty consists of the following: Novice Network Access EXP bonus when partying with a 78Mentor (up to Lv. 90) Returner online status icon Returner status is removed after accumulating 72 hours of gameplay after accepting the Bounty, or by using the text command .
